brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu denied Monday circulating reports that he intended to dismiss Eyal Zamir, the chief of the Israeli military's general staff, Middle East Eye reported.

The denial came after multiple Israeli media outlets published accounts suggesting Netanyahu would remove Zamir from his position. No further details were provided regarding the basis for the initial reports or Netanyahu's reasons for the denial.
dek: Netanyahu denies reports he will fire chief of staff Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu denied on Monday reports circulating in Israeli media regarding firing the Israeli military chief, Eyal Zamir.
title: Netanyahu denies plans to fire military chief Zamir
